confirmed_by_brochure.document: Alcoa MIC 6 brochure (4-2016), specifications table on PDF page 8, read visually by the collector
confirmed_by_brochure.applied: 2026-11-15: MATERIALS['al_mic6'] E 71,000 and yield 105 are now the maker's typical figures (the numbers did not move); fea.ALPHA 23.6e-6 confirmed; tolerance STOCK_PLATE_FLATNESS for al_mic6 is the maker's own (0.381 mm for 1/4 to 5/8 in plate; a 6.0 mm plate is below the 6.35 mm the brochure starts at)

density_note.status: NOT in the Alcoa brochure. 2800 kg/m3 is an input assumption of a third-party thermal report (NOVA, ATR chassis, Table 1) and equals 0.101 lb/in3 on a distributor's page, which also prints 2.7 g/cm3: no density is certified. Kept; ask for a material certificate for mass-critical work

specific_heat_j_kgk.source: the same NOVA report input, not the maker

confirmed_by_snippet.alloy: cast in AA 5083-type alloy (magnesium the main alloying element); about 5 % lighter than MIC-6-type plate

recalled: nu (typical for aluminium; not on the maker's sheet)

confirmed_by_datasheet.values: density 2660, E 70,000 MPa (10.1 Msi; was 70,300 recalled), yield 124, tensile 283, expansion 23.6e-6 /K at 20-100 degC (was 23.8e-6 recalled), 140 W/m.K

not_obtained: flatness and thickness tolerances (MIC-6: recalled +/-0.005 in thickness, 0.015 in flatness under 3/4 in)
